questions.stem: Which of the following is the general form of the distributive property for two expressions each with two terms?
choices: (a + b) × (c + d) = ac + ad + bc + bd
(a + b) × (c + d) = a + b + c + d
questions.solution: The correct option shows the proper expansion of two binomials, where each term in the first binomial is multiplied by each term in the second binomial, resulting in four terms: ac + ad + bc + bd. The other options fail to account for all possible products, either by omitting terms or incorrectly combining them.

questions.stem: Which of the following expressions is equivalent to (x + 2)(x + 5)?
questions.solution: The correct expansion of (x + 2)(x + 5) is x^2 + 7x + 10. The other options are incorrect because they have incorrect coefficients for x or the constant term.

hi.stem: निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा व्यंजक (x + 2)(x + 5) के समतुल्य है?

questions.stem: If 26 × 74 is compared to 25 × 75, which product is larger?
questions.solution: By using the identity (a + b)(a - b) = a² - b², 25 × 75 can be seen as (50 - 25)(50 + 25) = 50² - 25², while 26 × 74 is (50 - 24)(50 + 24) = 50² - 24². Since 25² is greater than 24², 25 × 75 is larger. The other options misinterpret the comparison based on the identity.

hi.stem: यदि 26 × 74 की तुलना 25 × 75 से की जाए, तो कौन-सा गुणनफल बड़ा है?
hi.solution: सर्वसमिका (a + b)(a - b) = a² - b² का उपयोग करके, 25 × 75 को (50 - 25)(50 + 25) = 50² - 25² के रूप में देखा जा सकता है, जबकि 26 × 74 को (50 - 24)(50 + 24) = 50² - 24² के रूप में देखा जा सकता है। 25², 24² से बड़ा होने के कारण 25 × 75 बड़ा है। अन्य विकल्प सर्वसमिका के आधार पर तुलना के गलत अर्थ करते हैं।
hi.critique: The Hindi translation is accurate, maintains the same meaning, and uses appropriate mathematical terminology as found in Hindi-medium textbooks.

mr.stem: 26 × 74 ची तुलना 25 × 75 शी केली गेली असता, कोणता गुणाकार जास्त आहे?
mr.solution: समीकरण (a + b)(a - b) = a² - b² चा वापर करून, 25 × 75 ला (50 - 25)(50 + 25) = 50² - 25² म्हणून पाहता जाते, तर 26 × 74 हे (50 - 24)(50 + 24) = 50² - 24² म्हणून पाहता जाते. कारण 25² 24² पेक्षा जास्त आहे, 25 × 75 जास्त आहे. इतर विकल्पांमध्ये समीकरणावर आधारित तुलनेचा चुकीचा अर्थ केला जातो.
mr.critique: The translation is accurate, maintains the mathematical meaning, and uses appropriate Marathi terminology.
